messages:
Jamal T (eng-ml): Heads up — CI gating just flagged a bad regression for the new 4-bit quant bring-up. nightly-evals/buildkite failed: MRR down ~9% vs baseline. The eval-runner log shows a ValueError during logits aggregation. Anyone seen this with quantized sharded models?

CI Bot: buildkite: https://buildkite.example.com/orgs/redwood/pipelines/nightly-evals/builds/4821 (job: eval-runner-quant) — exit code 1. Artifact: s3://redwood-evals/4821/artifacts/logs/eval-runner.log

Anna K (ml-eng): Ugh. Can you paste the failing command + the eval config? My guess is the runner mis-handling of KV cache shapes when using the quantized checkpoint + torch's F16->INT8 cast.

Jamal T (eng-ml): Repro snippet from the job:
```
BUCKET=s3://redwood-evals/4821
python -m evals.runner --model redwood-4bit-v1 --split test --batch-size 8 --shard-kv --save-preds $BUCKET/preds.jsonl
```
Stack trace (tail):
```
File "evaluator.py", line 213, in aggregate_logits
  logits = torch.cat(per_shard_logits, dim=1)
ValueError: expected shape[1] to match, got 512 vs 504
```

Miguel R (devex): Looks like one shard produced a different sequence length (504 vs 512). Could be a padding bug in loader or a bug in how the quantized kernel truncates last tokens. Two immediate CI actions: 1) we should fail fast but collect artifacts (preds + per-shard meta) for triage; 2) temporarily gate PRs that change runner/quantization until we have a mitigator.

Sophie L (infra): I can patch the buildkite pipeline to persist the full per-shard metadata artifacts and enable a post-step that runs a small consistency check script. Example check: verify all per_shard_logits shapes equal and raise a non-zero warning code instead of crash so we can fail the job with better diagnostics. I'll add an artifact TTL of 30 days.

Anna K (ml-eng): Also want to propose CI gating thresholds for quality regressions: any run with MRR drop > 5% (or EM drop > 3% on our retrieval evals) should block merge, but with an automatic rerun and a triage label. For quantization-specific PRs maybe stricter: 2% MRR. We need the metric definitions in the PR output too (baseline version, delta, p-value).

Jamal T (eng-ml): Agree. The tricky part: our current GH Actions gating (pr-evals.yml) only checks a simple pass/fail. We need to wire the eval artifact output (JSON metrics) back into the PR check. Can we add a step that posts a comment summarizing metrics?

Miguel R (devex): Yes — we have a small GH Action (actions/post-eval-comment) the devex team maintains. Plan: 1) Buildkite nightly runs the full eval and uploads metrics to s3. 2) PR-level GH Actions runs a lightweight subset (smoke) and downloads baseline metrics from s3 (version pinned by model hash). 3) Compare and if delta > threshold, add 'eval-regression' check failure and post comment with details + link to artifacts. I can open a PR to wire the action by EOD.

CI Bot: NOTE: there is already a Buildkite trigger from GH that can run a 'full-eval' label. Current default is off for PRs.

Sophie L (infra): For reliability, we should also add a nightly job that compiles a baseline artifact for each model version (store preds + metrics) so PR-level checks have a stable baseline. I'll schedule nightly-bake at 02:30 UTC. That will also help with flaky divergence due to non-deterministic quant kernels.

Anna K (ml-eng): On the eval-runner bug — Jamal, can you add a tiny patch to checkpoint the per-shard shapes to the artifact before the cat() call? If we have the shapes, we can quickly detect mismatch and skip the concat to produce a clearer error message. I'll prepare a minimal PR with tests.

Jamal T (eng-ml): Will do and include a unit test that simulates uneven shard lengths. Also adding a fallback that pads to max length with -inf logits (so argmax unaffected) as a temporary workaround.

Miguel R (devex): I'll open PR #6142 to the repo: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/6142 — it wires actions/post-eval-comment and adds threshold config in .github/eval-config.toml. The action will set a check named "eval/metrics" and annotate the PR with per-metric diffs.

Ops Bot: Reminder: owners for eval infra are @Sophie L and @Miguel R. Use pager for SEV if nightly-bake fails 3 days in a row.

Sophie L (infra): Followups:
- I'll add artifact persists + shape-check step in Buildkite today.
- Add nightly-bake cron at 02:30 UTC.
- Grant Jamal temporary write to s3 bucket for tests.

Anna K (ml-eng): Followups from ML side:
- Jamal to PR runner patch + unit tests (blocking).
- I will add regression thresholds to the eval spec and sample size checks (n>500).
- Create an internal dashboard tile to show latest nightly baseline vs last PR run. (assign to Miguel for dashboard plumbing)

Jamal T (eng-ml): Thanks. I'll push the runner patch now and trigger a manual rerun of the failing build.

CI Bot: buildkite: rerun requested by Jamal T — https://buildkite.example.com/.../builds/4821#retry

Miguel R (devex): I'll follow up with the GH Action PR and add a sample annotated comment format:
```
Eval results for PR #6142:
- Model: redwood-4bit-v1 (hash: abc123)
- Metric: MRR (baseline 0.612 -> PR 0.555) delta -9.3% (threshold: -2%)
- Status: FAIL (eval/metrics)
Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/pr-6142/
```

Anna K (ml-eng): When this lands we should do a dry run (annotate only, no blocking) for 48h. Then flip to blocking for quantization PR labels.

Jamal T (eng-ml): Updated build passed the shape-check but still saw a small numeric shift after padding — investigating. Will post a short summary in this thread when I have root cause. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

(reacts :eyes:)
